name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3436: v3435 bounded the CDP read and the cross-family eye proved it did not work: check() finally makes three more ev() calls, each swallowing its own timeout, so a quiet socket cost 4 x 90s = 360s against the hook 300s SIGTERM and the UNKNOWN line was never written. _Tab now REMEMBERS a dead transport and answers instantly; close() aborts instead of handshaking a corpse; and PUT /json/new — the sibling socket one line below the one v3435 fixed — is bounded too. Only a TRANSPORT error marks the tab dead, never a page exception, so the v3051 in-page collector still runs. 7/7 red-proofs.
